about.title: Dixon Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a traffic collision takes a life in Dixon, the aftermath is overwhelming. Solano County recorded one traffic death alongside 77 injury collisions and 92 people injured in the most recent final crash year, numbers that remind us these losses happen on the same streets families drive every day — I-80, Rt 113, West A Street, and Pitt School Road among them. Crashes here tend to cluster on Saturday afternoons, but a fatal collision can happen anytime, anywhere in town. California law gives surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. LawProactive is not a law firm — we're a free service that connects grieving Dixon families with an independent personal injury attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there's no upfront cost while you focus on your family.

whyChoose.title: Why Dixon Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases to spouses, domestic partners, and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain circumstances. An independent attorney can help clarify where your family stands.

items.title: A Firm Deadline That Doesn't Wait
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, though claims against a government entity involve a much shorter window. Given how quickly that time can pass during grief, getting guidance early matters.

items.title: No Fee Unless There's a Recovery
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning families pay nothing upfront and owe no fee unless money is recovered. That structure lets you get help without adding financial strain to an already difficult time.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Under California law, a spouse or domestic partner and children have the first right to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may be eligible depending on the family's circumstances. An independent attorney can review your specific situation to explain where you fit.

items.question: How long do we have to file after losing a family member in a Dixon crash?
items.answer: Generally, California gives two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If the crash involved a government vehicle or a government-maintained road, such as certain stretches near I-80 or Pitt School Road, the deadline can be much shorter. Talking to an attorney soon after a loss helps make sure that window isn't missed.

items.question: What kinds of losses can a wrongful death claim cover?
items.answer: California law allows recovery for things like funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. It does not put a price on grief itself, but it can help address the real financial and emotional impact a family carries. Every family's losses look different, which is why individual legal guidance matters.
